_rules: Reviewed lines for the avatar's check-ins (#25). The avatar speaks in its own warm voice. Never: 'you haven't...', 'you broke your streak', guilt, scores, relapse, diagnoses, the clinic or doctors. Never mention how long the gap was. tests/test_companion.py checks every line against these rules.

missed_one_after_streak.text: I kept your spot warm yesterday. Want to tell me about today?
I saved you a seat by the window. Tell me how today is going?
Just a little hello from me. I'd love to hear about your day.

missed_few.text: I've missed hearing from you. Even ten seconds is enough.
Thinking of you today. If talking feels like a lot, you can type a few words instead.
No rush at all. Whenever you feel like it, a few words is plenty.

short_memos.text: Short days count too. Want to try today's small thing together?
Some days are quieter, and that's okay. Shall we do today's small thing together?

back_after_break.text: There you are! I'm so glad to see you.
Hello again! It's really nice to hear from you.
Oh, hi! You just made my day brighter.
